Install omadesign on Omarchy

Native Linux studio for design, layout, painting, photography, and motion

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omadesign-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.6.3-1:
    pacman -Qi omadesign-bin

Open and use omadesign

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql omadesign-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omadesign on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omadesign-bin. The download is 38.2 MB and it takes 85 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omadesign free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT, CDDL-1.0.

How do I uninstall omadesign?

Run omarchy pkg drop omadesign-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does omadesign depend on?

The package declares 14 dependencies: glibc, gcc-libs, fontconfig, hicolor-icon-theme, libglvnd, libx11, libxcursor, libxi, libxrandr, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, vulkan-icd-loader and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omadesign in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omadesign-bin (version 0.6.3-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. michaelmonetized makes it. Project site: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omadesign.
